commits.author: giuliastro
commits.subject: feat(web): expose session actions when the transcript is empty
commits.body:
Undo can strip the transcript to nothing, leaving Redo enabled but
unreachable through the message context menu, which needs a bubble to
exist. Add an always-available actions menu in the conversation header
that renders the harness/extension-provided actions, so their
availability no longer depends on the transcript contents.

Closes #104

commits.author: Noam Siegel
commits.subject: Serve the harness command catalog so OMP slash commands reach the app
commits.body:
The bridge already captured `available_commands_update` into `#commandCatalogs`
(acp-service.js), but only `actions()` read it, `GET /command` returned a
hardcoded `[]`, and the OMP profile advertised `commands: false`. So the app hid
the command surface entirely for OMP even though the harness advertises 80
commands over ACP, 30 of them skills.

- AcpService#commands(sessionID) maps the catalog to the app's CommandInfo shape
  and tags `skill:`-prefixed names as `source: "skill"`, which the app's existing
  skill-only filter in Help -> Commands already knows how to render. Without a
  sessionID it answers from the newest catalog, because the app loads the picker
  before any session is selected.
- POST /session/:id/command sends `/name args` as prompt text. ACP has no command
  channel; a slash-prefixed prompt is what the composer would have sent anyway,
  and OMP executes it. Previously this route 404'd, so enabling the capability
  without it would have broken every command the app offered.
- The OMP profile now reports `commands: true`. Note the `pi` profile already
  did, so PI clients were being offered a picker that `/command` answered with an
  empty list; they get the real catalog now too, if their adapter advertises one.

Verified against OMP 17.2.2: GET /command returns 79 entries (30 skills, 49
commands), and the deployed PWA lists all 30 under Help -> Commands.

+/** Advertises a skill command alongside the extension ones, as OMP does. */
+class SkillCommandAcp extends ExtensionActionAcp {
+  async request(method, params) {
+    const result = await super.request(method, params)
+    if (method === "session/load") {
+      this.emit("notification", {
+        method: "session/update",
+        params: {
+          sessionId: "session-1",
+          update: {
+            sessionUpdate: "available_commands_update",
+            availableCommands: [
+              { name: "model", description: "Show current model selection" },
+              { name: "skill:memory", description: "Runtime-boundary guidance for memory" }
+            ]
+          }
+        }
+      })
+    }
+    return result
+  }
+}
+
+test("serves the harness command catalog and marks skills by source", async () => {
+  const bridge = await startServer({ acp: new SkillCommandAcp() })
+  try {
+    const scoped = await readJSON(bridge.baseURL, "/command?sessionID=session-1")
+    assert.deepEqual(scoped, [
+      { name: "model", description: "Show current model selection", source: "command" },
+      { name: "skill:memory", description: "Runtime-boundary guidance for memory", source: "skill" }
+    ])
+    // The app asks for the picker without a session, so the newest catalog has to answer.
+    assert.deepEqual(await readJSON(bridge.baseURL, "/command"), scoped)
+  } finally {
+    await bridge.close()
+  }
+})
+
+test("sends a picked command to the harness as slash-prefixed prompt text", async () => {

+
+    await readJSON(bridge.baseURL, "/session/session-1/command", {
+      method: "POST",

+    })

+    const rejected = await fetch(`${bridge.baseURL}/session/session-1/command`, {
